id-20261123-news-1.title: Indonesia's Trade Balance Surplus January–September 2026: How to Read Exports, Imports, and Their Impact on Foreign Exchange Reserves and the Rupiah

segments.src: Surplus neraca perdagangan kumulatif Indonesia pada periode Januari–September 2026 dilaporkan mencapai sekitar **US$10,6 miliar**.
segments.tr: Indonesia's cumulative trade balance surplus for the January–September 2026 period was reported to reach around **US$10.6 billion**.

segments.src: Angka ini sering menjadi bahan berita ekonomi, tetapi tidak selalu mudah dipahami.
segments.tr: This figure often becomes economic news, but it is not always easy to understand.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara membaca data Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), apa yang biasanya menopang ekspor, bagaimana struktur impor bekerja, dan mengapa semua itu berkaitan dengan stabilitas rupiah.
segments.tr: This article explains how to read data from Statistics Indonesia (BPS), what usually supports exports, how import structures work, and why all of this relates to the stability of the rupiah.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Angka dalam artikel ini mengacu pada pemberitaan dan rilis resmi yang tersedia saat penulisan. Untuk angka terbaru dan paling akurat, rujuklah langsung publikasi BPS. Artikel ini bersifat edukatif dan bukan saran investasi.
segments.tr: > **Note:** The figures in this article refer to news and official releases available at the time of writing. For the latest and most accurate figures, refer directly to BPS publications. This article is educational and not investment advice.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu Neraca Perdagangan?
segments.tr: ## What Is a Trade Balance?

segments.src: Neraca perdagangan adalah selisih antara nilai **ekspor** dan **impor** barang dalam suatu periode.
segments.tr: The trade balance is the difference between the value of **exports** and **imports** of goods over a certain period.

segments.src: - **Surplus**: nilai ekspor lebih besar daripada impor.
segments.tr: - **Surplus**: the value of exports is greater than imports.

segments.src: - **Defisit**: nilai impor lebih besar daripada ekspor.
segments.tr: - **Deficit**: the value of imports is greater than exports.

segments.src: Neraca perdagangan merupakan salah satu komponen utama transaksi berjalan dalam neraca pembayaran.
segments.tr: The trade balance is one of the main components of the current account in the balance of payments.

segments.src: Surplus perdagangan barang umumnya membantu menopang pasokan valuta asing di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: A merchandise trade surplus generally helps support the supply of foreign exchange domestically.

segments.src: Meski begitu, neraca perdagangan bukan satu-satunya penentu kondisi eksternal suatu negara.
segments.tr: Even so, the trade balance is not the sole determinant of a country's external condition.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Rilis Data BPS
segments.tr: ## How to Read BPS Data Releases

segments.src: BPS biasanya merilis data perdagangan luar negeri setiap bulan.
segments.tr: BPS usually releases foreign trade data every month.

segments.src: Agar tidak salah tafsir, perhatikan hal berikut.
segments.tr: To avoid misinterpretation, pay attention to the following.

segments.src: ### 1. Bedakan angka bulanan dan kumulatif
segments.tr: ### 1. Distinguish between monthly and cumulative figures

segments.src: Angka **bulanan** menggambarkan kondisi satu bulan saja dan bisa berfluktuasi tajam karena faktor musiman, hari kerja, atau pengiriman besar.
segments.tr: **Monthly** figures describe conditions for a single month only and can fluctuate sharply due to seasonal factors, working days, or large shipments.

segments.src: Angka **kumulatif** (Januari–September) meredam fluktuasi itu dan lebih cocok untuk melihat tren.
segments.tr: **Cumulative** figures (January–September) smooth out those fluctuations and are better suited for observing trends.

segments.src: Surplus sekitar US$10,6 miliar adalah hasil akumulasi sembilan bulan, bukan capaian satu bulan.
segments.tr: A surplus of about US$10.6 billion is the result of a nine-month accumulation, not a single month's achievement.

segments.src: ### 2. Perhatikan pembanding
segments.tr: ### 2. Pay attention to comparators

segments.src: Data biasanya dibandingkan dalam dua cara:
segments.tr: Data is usually compared in two ways:

segments.src: - **Month-to-month (m-to-m)**: dibandingkan dengan bulan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: - **Month-to-month (m-to-m)**: compared to the previous month.

segments.src: - **Year-on-year (y-on-y)**: dibandingkan dengan bulan atau periode yang sama tahun lalu.
segments.tr: - **Year-on-year (y-on-y)**: compared to the same month or period last year.

segments.src: Pembanding tahunan lebih berguna untuk menghindari bias musiman, misalnya efek Ramadan, libur panjang, atau musim panen.
segments.tr: Annual comparators are more useful to avoid seasonal bias, such as the effect of Ramadan, long holidays, or the harvest season.

segments.src: ### 3. Pisahkan migas dan nonmigas
segments.tr: ### 3. Separate oil & gas and non-oil & gas

segments.src: BPS memisahkan perdagangan **migas** dan **nonmigas**.
segments.tr: BPS separates **oil and gas** and **non-oil and gas** trade.

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, surplus Indonesia umumnya ditopang sektor nonmigas, sedangkan sektor migas cenderung defisit karena Indonesia masih mengimpor sebagian kebutuhan minyak dan produk olahannya.
segments.tr: In recent years, Indonesia's surplus has generally been supported by the non-oil and gas sector, while the oil and gas sector tends to be in deficit because Indonesia still imports part of its oil needs and processed products.

segments.src: ### 4. Lihat nilai, volume, dan harga
segments.tr: ### 4. Look at value, volume, and price

segments.src: Kenaikan nilai ekspor bisa berasal dari kenaikan **harga**, kenaikan **volume**, atau keduanya.
segments.tr: An increase in export value can come from rising **prices**, rising **volume**, or both.

segments.src: Jika nilai naik hanya karena harga komoditas global, surplus lebih rentan berbalik ketika harga turun.
segments.tr: If the value rises solely due to global commodity prices, the surplus is more vulnerable to reversing when prices fall.

segments.src: ### 5. Perhatikan revisi dan periode pelaporan
segments.tr: ### 5. Watch for revisions and reporting periods

segments.src: Data dapat direvisi pada rilis berikutnya.
segments.tr: Data can be revised in subsequent releases.

segments.src: Karena itu, bandingkan angka dari rilis resmi yang sama dan jangan mencampur sumber yang metodenya berbeda.
segments.tr: Therefore, compare figures from the same official release and do not mix sources with different methodologies.

segments.src: ## Komoditas yang Biasanya Menopang Ekspor
segments.tr: ## Commodities That Usually Support Exports

segments.src: Struktur ekspor Indonesia relatif terkonsentrasi pada beberapa kelompok komoditas.
segments.tr: Indonesia's export structure is relatively concentrated in a few commodity groups.

segments.src: Komoditas yang lazim menjadi penopang adalah:
segments.tr: Commonly supporting commodities are:

segments.src: | Kelompok | Contoh | Catatan |
segments.tr: | Group | Example | Notes |

segments.src: | Bahan bakar mineral | Batu bara | Sangat dipengaruhi harga energi global dan permintaan negara mitra |
segments.tr: | Mineral fuels | Coal | Heavily influenced by global energy prices and partner country demand |

segments.src: | Lemak dan minyak hewan/nabati | Minyak kelapa sawit (CPO) dan turunannya | Dipengaruhi harga global, kebijakan ekspor, dan produksi |
segments.tr: | Animal/vegetable fats and oils | Crude palm oil (CPO) and its derivatives | Influenced by global prices, export policies, and production |

segments.src: | Besi dan baja | Produk hilirisasi nikel | Tumbuh seiring kebijakan hilirisasi |
segments.tr: | Iron and steel | Nickel downstream products | Growing alongside downstream policies |

segments.src: | Nikel dan produk turunannya | Feronikel, bahan baterai | Bergantung pada permintaan industri kendaraan listrik dan baja nirkarat |
segments.tr: | Nickel and its derivatives | Ferronickel, battery materials | Dependent on demand from the electric vehicle and stainless steel industries |

segments.src: | Produk manufaktur | Mesin, elektronik, tekstil, alas kaki | Lebih stabil, tetapi sensitif terhadap permintaan global |
segments.tr: | Manufactured products | Machinery, electronics, textiles, footwear | More stable, but sensitive to global demand |

segments.src: Tujuan ekspor yang dominan umumnya adalah Tiongkok, Amerika Serikat, India, Jepang, dan negara-negara ASEAN.
segments.tr: Dominant export destinations are generally China, the United States, India, Japan, and ASEAN countries.

segments.src: Ketergantungan pada beberapa mitra dagang berarti perlambatan ekonomi di salah satu negara tersebut dapat memengaruhi ekspor Indonesia.
segments.tr: Reliance on a few trading partners means that an economic slowdown in any of those countries can affect Indonesia's exports.

segments.src: ## Struktur Impor: Bukan Sekadar "Barang Asing"
segments.tr: ## Import Structure: More Than Just "Foreign Goods"

segments.src: Impor sering dianggap negatif, padahal komposisinya penting.
segments.tr: Imports are often considered negative, even though their composition is important.

segments.src: BPS mengelompokkan impor menjadi tiga golongan besar:
segments.tr: BPS categorizes imports into three major groups:

segments.src: 1. **Bahan baku/penolong**: bahan yang dipakai industri dalam negeri. Porsinya biasanya terbesar. Kenaikannya dapat menandakan aktivitas produksi yang menggeliat.
segments.tr: 1. **Raw/auxiliary materials**: materials used by domestic industries. Their portion is usually the largest. Increases can signal burgeoning production activity.

segments.src: 2. **Barang modal**: mesin dan peralatan untuk investasi. Kenaikannya sering mencerminkan ekspansi usaha dan dapat mendorong produktivitas di masa depan.
segments.tr: 2. **Capital goods**: machinery and equipment for investment. Increases often reflect business expansion and can drive future productivity.

segments.src: 3. **Barang konsumsi**: barang jadi untuk konsumen. Porsinya relatif kecil.
segments.tr: 3. **Consumer goods**: finished goods for consumers. Their portion is relatively small.

segments.src: Karena itu, penurunan impor tidak otomatis kabar baik.
segments.tr: Therefore, a drop in imports is not automatically good news.

segments.src: Jika impor bahan baku dan barang modal melemah tajam, hal itu bisa berarti industri dan investasi sedang melambat.
segments.tr: If raw material and capital goods imports weaken sharply, it could mean industry and investment are slowing down.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, surplus yang naik akibat impor yang melemah memiliki makna berbeda dibanding surplus yang naik akibat ekspor yang kuat.
segments.tr: Conversely, a surplus rising due to weakened imports has a different meaning than a surplus rising due to strong exports.

segments.src: ## Kaitannya dengan Cadangan Devisa
segments.tr: ## Link to Foreign Exchange Reserves

segments.src: Cadangan devisa adalah aset valuta asing yang dikelola bank sentral, yaitu Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: Foreign exchange reserves are foreign currency assets managed by the central bank, namely Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: Surplus perdagangan menambah pasokan devisa ke perekonomian, tetapi perubahan cadangan devisa dipengaruhi banyak faktor lain, antara lain:
segments.tr: A trade surplus adds foreign exchange supply to the economy, but changes in foreign exchange reserves are influenced by many other factors, among others:

segments.src: - Penerimaan dan pembayaran utang luar negeri pemerintah.
segments.tr: - Government external debt receipts and payments.

segments.src: - Aliran modal portofolio (investasi di pasar saham dan obligasi).
segments.tr: - Portfolio capital flows (investment in stock and bond markets).

segments.src: - Investasi langsung asing.
segments.tr: - Foreign direct investment.

segments.src: - Pembayaran dividen dan bunga kepada investor asing.
segments.tr: - Dividend and interest payments to foreign investors.

segments.src: - Intervensi Bank Indonesia di pasar valuta asing.
segments.tr: - Bank Indonesia interventions in the foreign exchange market.

segments.src: - Pergerakan kurs mata uang utama terhadap dolar AS, yang memengaruhi nilai aset cadangan.
segments.tr: - Movements of major currency exchange rates against the US dollar, which affect the value of reserve assets.

segments.src: Dengan demikian, surplus perdagangan adalah **salah satu penopang**, bukan jaminan kenaikan cadangan devisa pada bulan yang sama.
segments.tr: Thus, a trade surplus is **one support**, not a guarantee of an increase in foreign exchange reserves in the same month.

segments.src: Cadangan devisa yang memadai biasanya dinilai dengan ukuran seperti kecukupan untuk membiayai impor dan pembayaran utang luar negeri pemerintah dalam beberapa bulan.
segments.tr: Adequate foreign exchange reserves are typically assessed by metrics such as sufficiency to finance imports and government external debt payments for several months.

segments.src: ## Kaitannya dengan Stabilitas Rupiah
segments.tr: ## Link to Rupiah Stability

segments.src: Hubungan antara surplus dagang dan rupiah dapat dipahami lewat pasokan dan permintaan valuta asing:
segments.tr: The relationship between the trade surplus and the rupiah can be understood through foreign currency supply and demand:

segments.src: - **Eksportir** menerima devisa dan sebagian menukarkannya ke rupiah, sehingga menambah pasokan dolar di pasar domestik.
segments.tr: - **Exporters** receive foreign exchange and some convert it to rupiah, thereby increasing the supply of dollars in the domestic market.

segments.src: - **Importir** membutuhkan dolar untuk membayar barang, sehingga menambah permintaan.
segments.tr: - **Importers** need dollars to pay for goods, thereby increasing demand.

segments.src: - Surplus berarti arus devisa masuk dari perdagangan barang lebih besar daripada arus keluar. Hal ini cenderung memberi bantalan bagi nilai tukar.
segments.tr: - A surplus means foreign exchange inflows from merchandise trade are greater than outflows. This tends to provide a cushion for the exchange rate.

segments.src: Namun, rupiah juga dipengaruhi faktor lain yang sering lebih dominan dalam jangka pendek:
segments.tr: However, the rupiah is also influenced by other factors that are often more dominant in the short term:

segments.src: - Arah suku bunga dan kebijakan moneter Amerika Serikat serta Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: - The direction of interest rates and monetary policy in the United States and Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: - Selisih imbal hasil (yield) obligasi Indonesia dengan negara lain.
segments.tr: - The yield differential between Indonesian bonds and other countries.

segments.src: - Sentimen risiko global dan ketegangan geopolitik.
segments.tr: - Global risk sentiment and geopolitical tensions.

segments.src: - Aliran dana asing ke pasar keuangan domestik.
segments.tr: - Foreign fund flows into domestic financial markets.

segments.src: - Defisit pada pos lain, misalnya jasa dan pendapatan primer, yang pada neraca transaksi berjalan sering negatif.
segments.tr: - Deficits in other accounts, such as services and primary income, which are often negative in the current account.

segments.src: - Kebijakan terkait devisa hasil ekspor di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: - Policies related to domestic export proceeds.

segments.src: Jadi, surplus perdagangan memperkuat fondasi, tetapi pergerakan harian rupiah tetap bisa naik-turun karena faktor eksternal.
segments.tr: So, a trade surplus strengthens the foundation, but daily rupiah movements can still fluctuate due to external factors.

segments.src: ## Risiko yang Perlu Dicermati
segments.tr: ## Risks to Watch Out For

segments.src: Surplus sekitar US$10,6 miliar memang positif, tetapi ada beberapa hal yang layak diwaspadai:
segments.tr: A surplus of about US$10.6 billion is positive, but there are several things worth watching out for:

segments.src: 1. **Ketergantungan komoditas.** Jika harga batu bara, CPO, atau nikel turun, nilai ekspor dapat tertekan.
segments.tr: 1. **Commodity dependence.** If coal, CPO, or nickel prices drop, export values can be pressured.

segments.src: 2. **Permintaan dari mitra dagang utama.** Perlambatan ekonomi global atau perubahan kebijakan tarif dapat memengaruhi pengiriman.
segments.tr: 2. **Demand from major trading partners.** A global economic slowdown or changes in tariff policies can affect shipments.

segments.src: 3. **Kualitas surplus.** Surplus akibat impor lemah berbeda dengan surplus akibat ekspor kuat.
segments.tr: 3. **Quality of the surplus.** A surplus due to weak imports is different from a surplus due to strong exports.

segments.src: 4. **Defisit migas.** Kebutuhan impor energi membuat sektor ini tetap menjadi beban.
segments.tr: 4. **Oil and gas deficit.** Energy import needs make this sector remain a burden.

segments.src: 5. **Pos lain dalam neraca pembayaran.** Surplus barang dapat tergerus oleh defisit jasa dan pembayaran pendapatan ke luar negeri.
segments.tr: 5. **Other accounts in the balance of payments.** Merchandise surpluses can be eroded by service deficits and income payments abroad.

segments.src: ## Cara Praktis Membaca Berita Surplus Dagang
segments.tr: ## Practical Ways to Read Trade Surplus News

segments.src: Saat membaca berita berikutnya, ajukan beberapa pertanyaan sederhana:
segments.tr: When reading the next news, ask a few simple questions:

segments.src: - Apakah angkanya bulanan atau kumulatif?
segments.tr: - Are the figures monthly or cumulative?

segments.src: - Dibandingkan dengan periode apa (m-to-m atau y-on-y)?
segments.tr: - Compared to what period (m-to-m or y-on-y)?

segments.src: - Apakah kenaikan ditopang ekspor atau hanya impor yang turun?
segments.tr: - Is the increase supported by exports or just falling imports?

segments.src: - Komoditas apa yang paling berkontribusi?
segments.tr: - Which commodities contribute the most?

segments.src: - Apakah impor bahan baku dan barang modal ikut bergerak?
segments.tr: - Are raw material and capital goods imports moving as well?

segments.src: - Apa kata data cadangan devisa dan neraca pembayaran dari Bank Indonesia?
segments.tr: - What do foreign exchange reserve and balance of payments data from Bank Indonesia say?

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Surplus perdagangan kumulatif Januari–September 2026 yang dilaporkan sekitar US$10,6 miliar menunjukkan bahwa arus devisa dari perdagangan barang masih positif.
segments.tr: The cumulative trade surplus for January–September 2026 reported at around US$10.6 billion indicates that foreign exchange flows from merchandise trade remain positive.

segments.src: Namun, angka tunggal tidak menceritakan seluruh kondisi.
segments.tr: However, a single figure does not tell the whole story.

segments.src: Pembaca perlu melihat komposisi ekspor, kualitas impor, tren harga komoditas, serta data neraca pembayaran dan cadangan devisa.
segments.tr: Readers need to look at export composition, import quality, commodity price trends, as well as balance of payments and foreign exchange reserve data.

segments.src: Dengan membaca data secara utuh, kita dapat memahami bahwa surplus dagang membantu menjaga ketahanan eksternal dan stabilitas rupiah, tetapi bukan satu-satunya faktor penentunya.
segments.tr: By reading the data as a whole, we can understand that the trade surplus helps maintain external resilience and rupiah stability, but it is not the sole determining factor.

segments.src: *Sumber rujukan yang disarankan: rilis resmi Badan Pusat Statistik (bps.go.id) dan publikasi Bank Indonesia (bi.go.id).
segments.tr: *Suggested reference sources: official releases from Statistics Indonesia (bps.go.id) and Bank Indonesia publications (bi.go.id).

id-20261123-news-2.title: Christmas and New Year 2026/27 Holidays: A Guide to Planning Your Trip, Monitoring Ticket Fares, and Avoiding Peak Traffic

segments.src: Setiap akhir tahun, jutaan orang di Indonesia bepergian untuk berkumpul dengan keluarga atau berlibur.
segments.tr: Every year-end, millions of people in Indonesia travel to gather with family or go on vacation.

segments.src: Periode Natal dan Tahun Baru (Nataru) 2026/27 diperkirakan kembali ramai, baik di jalan tol dan jalur arteri, stasiun kereta, pelabuhan, maupun bandara.
segments.tr: The Christmas and New Year (Nataru) 2026/27 period is expected to be busy again, both on toll roads and arterial routes, train stations, ports, and airports.

segments.src: Panduan ini membantu Anda membaca prakiraan puncak arus, memahami aturan tarif tiket, dan menyusun perjalanan yang aman, nyaman, dan hemat.
segments.tr: This guide helps you read peak traffic forecasts, understand ticket fare rules, and organize a safe, comfortable, and economical trip.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum. Tanggal libur, kebijakan tarif, dan rekayasa lalu lintas dapat berubah. Selalu periksa pengumuman resmi pemerintah, operator transportasi, dan kepolisian sebelum berangkat.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general information purposes. Holiday dates, fare policies, and traffic management may change. Always check official announcements from the government, transportation operators, and the police before departing.

segments.src: ## 1. Pahami Pola Arus Nataru
segments.tr: ## 1. Understand Nataru Traffic Patterns

segments.src: Pola perjalanan Nataru biasanya terbagi menjadi tiga fase:
segments.tr: Nataru travel patterns are usually divided into three phases:

segments.src: - **Arus keberangkatan:** Meningkat beberapa hari sebelum 25 Desember. Banyak orang berangkat menjelang Natal, terutama saat sore hingga malam setelah jam kerja.
segments.tr: - **Departure flow:** Increases a few days before December 25. Many people leave closer to Christmas, especially in the afternoon to evening after working hours.

segments.src: - **Puncak di sekitar pergantian tahun:** Lonjakan menuju kawasan wisata, seperti pegunungan, pantai, dan kota-kota tujuan liburan, terjadi menjelang 31 Desember.
segments.tr: - **Peak around the turn of the year:** The surge toward tourist areas, such as mountains, beaches, and holiday destination cities, occurs leading up to December 31.

segments.src: - **Arus balik:** Biasanya memuncak pada akhir pekan pertama Januari atau menjelang sekolah dan kantor kembali aktif.
segments.tr: - **Return flow:** Usually peaks on the first weekend of January or just before schools and offices become active again.

segments.src: Agar tidak terjebak di puncak keramaian, ikuti beberapa kebiasaan berikut:
segments.tr: To avoid getting stuck in the peak crowds, follow these habits:

segments.src: 1. **Cari tanggal "bahu" puncak.** Berangkat 2–3 hari lebih awal atau lebih lambat dari hari yang paling padat sering kali jauh lebih lancar.
segments.tr: 1. **Look for "shoulder" dates.** Departing 2–3 days earlier or later than the busiest days is often much smoother.

segments.src: 2. **Hindari jam sibuk.** Dini hari atau siang hari pada hari kerja biasanya lebih lengang dibanding sore dan malam.
segments.tr: 2. **Avoid peak hours.** Early morning or midday on weekdays is usually less crowded than the evening and night.

segments.src: 3. **Manfaatkan cuti.** Jika kantor mengizinkan, ambil cuti agar tidak terpaksa berangkat di hari paling ramai.
segments.tr: 3. **Utilize leave.** If your office allows it, take leave so you are not forced to depart on the busiest days.

segments.src: ## 2. Cara Membaca Prakiraan Puncak Arus
segments.tr: ## 2. How to Read Peak Traffic Forecasts

segments.src: Pemerintah, Kementerian Perhubungan, Korlantas Polri, operator tol, PT KAI, PT ASDP, dan pengelola bandara biasanya menyampaikan perkiraan jumlah pergerakan dan hari puncak menjelang Nataru.
segments.tr: The government, the Ministry of Transportation, the National Police Traffic Corps (Korlantas Polri), toll operators, PT KAI, PT ASDP, and airport management usually provide forecasts of movement numbers and peak days leading up to Nataru.

segments.src: Cara memanfaatkannya:
segments.tr: How to use them:

segments.src: - **Baca rentang, bukan angka tunggal.** Prakiraan adalah estimasi. Hari puncak dapat bergeser karena cuaca, kebijakan cuti bersama, atau kejadian di lapangan.
segments.tr: - **Read ranges, not single numbers.** Forecasts are estimates. Peak days can shift due to weather, joint leave policies, or events in the field.

segments.src: - **Pantau pembaruan.** Prakiraan sering diperbarui mendekati hari H. Ikuti akun resmi instansi terkait di media sosial dan situs resminya.
segments.tr: - **Monitor updates.** Forecasts are often updated closer to the date. Follow official accounts of relevant agencies on social media and their official websites.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan rekayasa lalu lintas.** Sistem satu arah (*one way*), ganjil-genap, atau pembatasan angkutan barang kadang diberlakukan di ruas tertentu. Ketahui aturannya sebelum berangkat.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to traffic management.** One-way systems (*one way*), odd-even policies, or freight transport restrictions are sometimes implemented on certain sections. Know the rules before departing.

segments.src: - **Gunakan data lalu lintas langsung.** Aplikasi peta dan informasi dari pengelola jalan tol membantu memilih waktu dan rute alternatif.
segments.tr: - **Use live traffic data.** Map applications and information from toll road operators help in choosing times and alternative routes.

segments.src: ## 3. Memahami Aturan Tarif Tiket
segments.tr: ## 3. Understanding Ticket Fare Rules

segments.src: Tarif tiket tidak diatur dengan cara yang sama di semua moda transportasi.
segments.tr: Ticket fares are not regulated in the same way across all modes of transportation.

segments.src: Berikut gambaran umumnya.
segments.tr: Here is a general overview.

segments.src: ### Pesawat
segments.tr: ### Airplane

segments.src: Tarif tiket pesawat kelas ekonomi untuk penerbangan berjadwal dalam negeri diatur dengan **tarif batas atas dan batas bawah** oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: Economy class airfares for scheduled domestic flights are regulated with **upper and lower limit tariffs** by the government.

segments.src: Maskapai tidak boleh menjual tiket kelas ekonomi di atas batas atas atau di bawah batas bawah.
segments.tr: Airlines are not allowed to sell economy class tickets above the upper limit or below the lower limit.

segments.src: Pada musim libur, harga cenderung mendekati batas atas karena permintaan tinggi.
segments.tr: During the holiday season, prices tend to approach the upper limit due to high demand.

segments.src: Pemerintah kadang memberikan kebijakan khusus, seperti insentif atau diskon, untuk periode tertentu.
segments.tr: The government sometimes provides special policies, such as incentives or discounts, for certain periods.

segments.src: Periksa informasi terbaru di kanal resmi Kementerian Perhubungan.
segments.tr: Check the latest information on the official Ministry of Transportation channel.

segments.src: Perlu diingat bahwa harga yang tampil bisa terdiri atas tarif dasar, pajak, iuran wajib, dan biaya layanan.
segments.tr: Keep in mind that the displayed price may consist of the base fare, taxes, mandatory contributions, and service fees.

segments.src: Perhatikan **total harga akhir** sebelum membayar.
segments.tr: Pay attention to the **final total price** before paying.

segments.src: ### Kereta api
segments.tr: ### Train

segments.src: Tarif kereta api jarak jauh ditetapkan oleh operator sesuai kelas dan relasi, dan dapat berbeda saat musim ramai.
segments.tr: Long-distance train fares are set by the operator according to class and route, and may differ during peak seasons.

segments.src: Tiket biasanya dijual beberapa bulan sebelum keberangkatan melalui aplikasi dan kanal resmi PT KAI.
segments.tr: Tickets are usually sold several months before departure through the PT KAI application and official channels.

segments.src: Pesan lebih awal untuk mendapat pilihan jam dan kursi terbaik.
segments.tr: Book early to get the best choice of times and seats.

segments.src: ### Kapal laut dan penyeberangan
segments.tr: ### Sea transport and ferries

segments.src: Tarif angkutan laut dan penyeberangan diatur oleh pemerintah sesuai kelas layanan dan lintasan.
segments.tr: Sea transport and ferry fares are regulated by the government according to service class and route.

segments.src: Untuk lintasan padat seperti Merak–Bakauheni, sistem tiket daring dan pemesanan jadwal (*booking* waktu masuk pelabuhan) sering diterapkan untuk mengurai antrean.
segments.tr: For busy routes such as Merak–Bakauheni, online ticketing systems and schedule reservations (*booking* port entry times) are often implemented to reduce queues.

segments.src: ### Bus dan travel
segments.tr: ### Bus and travel

segments.src: Tarif bus antarkota dapat naik saat musim libur.
segments.tr: Intercity bus fares may rise during the holiday season.

segments.src: Pastikan Anda membeli dari agen atau loket resmi, dan minta bukti pembayaran.
segments.tr: Ensure you buy from official agents or counters, and ask for proof of payment.

segments.src: ## 4. Tips Memantau Harga dan Mendapatkan Tiket Hemat
segments.tr: ## 4. Tips for Monitoring Prices and Getting Cheap Tickets

segments.src: - **Bandingkan beberapa platform.** Cek situs maskapai atau operator, serta agen daring terpercaya, lalu bandingkan total biaya.
segments.tr: - **Compare several platforms.** Check airline or operator websites, as well as trusted online agents, then compare the total costs.

segments.src: - **Aktifkan pengingat harga.** Banyak aplikasi menyediakan notifikasi saat harga turun.
segments.tr: - **Activate price alerts.** Many applications provide notifications when prices drop.

segments.src: - **Fleksibel dengan hari dan jam.** Penerbangan pagi buta atau malam hari dan keberangkatan di hari kerja umumnya lebih murah.
segments.tr: - **Be flexible with days and times.** Early morning or late-night flights and weekday departures are generally cheaper.

segments.src: - **Pertimbangkan bandara atau stasiun alternatif.** Kadang kota di sekitar tujuan menawarkan tarif lebih rendah.
segments.tr: - **Consider alternative airports or stations.** Sometimes cities around your destination offer lower fares.

segments.src: - **Baca syarat pembatalan dan perubahan jadwal.** Tiket murah sering memiliki batasan. Pastikan sesuai dengan rencana Anda.
segments.tr: - **Read cancellation and schedule change terms.** Cheap tickets often have restrictions. Ensure they align with your plans.

segments.src: - **Waspada penipuan.** Hindari tawaran harga yang terlalu murah, tautan tidak resmi, dan permintaan pembayaran ke rekening pribadi. Beli hanya melalui kanal resmi.
segments.tr: - **Beware of fraud.** Avoid offers with prices that are too low, unofficial links, and requests for payment to personal accounts. Buy only through official channels.

segments.src: - **Siapkan anggaran darurat.** Sisihkan dana untuk biaya tak terduga, seperti keterlambatan, penginapan tambahan, atau BBM.
segments.tr: - **Prepare an emergency budget.** Set aside funds for unexpected costs, such as delays, additional accommodation, or fuel.

segments.src: ## 5. Tips Perjalanan Darat
segments.tr: ## 5. Road Trip Tips

segments.src: - **Periksa kendaraan** sebelum berangkat: rem, ban (termasuk ban cadangan), lampu, aki, oli, dan air radiator.
segments.tr: - **Check your vehicle** before departing: brakes, tires (including spare tire), lights, battery, oil, and radiator water.

segments.src: - **Siapkan saldo uang elektronik** yang cukup untuk jalan tol dan pastikan kartu berfungsi.
segments.tr: - **Prepare sufficient electronic money balance** for toll roads and ensure the card is functioning.

segments.src: - **Istirahat tiap 2–3 jam.** Kantuk adalah salah satu penyebab kecelakaan terbesar. Jangan memaksakan diri.
segments.tr: - **Rest every 2–3 hours.** Drowsiness is one of the biggest causes of accidents. Do not push yourself.

segments.src: - **Patuhi batas kecepatan dan rambu.** Jangan menggunakan bahu jalan kecuali dalam keadaan darurat atau diarahkan petugas.
segments.tr: - **Obey speed limits and signs.** Do not use the road shoulder unless in an emergency or directed by officers.

segments.src: - **Isi bahan bakar sebelum masuk ruas padat** dan manfaatkan tempat istirahat (*rest area*) pada waktu yang tidak terlalu ramai.
segments.tr: - **Refuel before entering busy sections** and utilize rest areas (*rest area*) at times that are not too crowded.

segments.src: - **Simpan nomor darurat** seperti layanan jalan tol dan kepolisian, serta bagikan rute dan perkiraan waktu tiba kepada keluarga.
segments.tr: - **Save emergency numbers** such as toll road services and the police, and share your route and estimated time of arrival with family.

segments.src: ## 6. Tips Perjalanan Kereta, Laut, dan Udara
segments.tr: ## 6. Tips for Train, Sea, and Air Travel

segments.src: **Kereta:** Datang lebih awal, cek ketentuan verifikasi identitas dan bagasi, serta simpan tiket digital di ponsel dengan baterai yang cukup.
segments.tr: **Train:** Arrive early, check identity verification and baggage requirements, and keep your digital ticket on your phone with sufficient battery.

segments.src: **Laut:** Cuaca di perairan dapat berubah.
segments.tr: **Sea:** Weather at sea can change.

segments.src: Pantau prakiraan cuaca dan pengumuman otoritas pelabuhan.
segments.tr: Monitor weather forecasts and port authority announcements.

segments.src: Selalu gunakan pelampung bila diminta dan patuhi arahan awak kapal.
segments.tr: Always use a life jacket if requested and follow the crew's directions.

segments.src: **Udara:** Tiba di bandara lebih awal dari biasanya karena antrean pemeriksaan dan *check-in* lebih panjang saat musim libur.
segments.tr: **Air:** Arrive at the airport earlier than usual because security and *check-in* queues are longer during the holiday season.

segments.src: Periksa batas bagasi dan barang yang dilarang dibawa ke kabin.
segments.tr: Check baggage limits and items prohibited from being carried into the cabin.

segments.src: Lakukan *check-in* daring bila tersedia.
segments.tr: Perform online *check-in* if available.

segments.src: ## 7. Menjaga Kesehatan dan Keselamatan
segments.tr: ## 7. Maintaining Health and Safety

segments.src: - Bawa obat pribadi, masker, hand sanitizer, dan air minum yang cukup.
segments.tr: - Bring personal medication, masks, hand sanitizer, and sufficient drinking water.

segments.src: - Jaga stamina dengan tidur cukup sebelum berangkat.
segments.tr: - Maintain stamina by getting enough sleep before departing.

segments.src: - Bila bepergian dengan anak atau lansia, rencanakan jeda istirahat lebih sering dan pastikan mereka nyaman.
segments.tr: - If traveling with children or the elderly, plan for more frequent rest breaks and ensure they are comfortable.

segments.src: - Titipkan rumah kepada tetangga atau petugas keamanan, matikan peralatan listrik, dan kunci semua akses.
segments.tr: - Entrust your house to neighbors or security personnel, turn off electrical appliances, and lock all access points.

segments.src: - Jaga barang berharga dan dokumen penting, seperti KTP, SIM, dan tiket, di tempat yang mudah dijangkau namun aman.
segments.tr: - Keep valuables and important documents, such as ID cards, driver's licenses, and tickets, in a place that is easily accessible but safe.

segments.src: ## 8. Daftar Periksa Singkat Sebelum Berangkat
segments.tr: ## 8. Short Checklist Before Departing

segments.src: 1. Tentukan tanggal berangkat dan pulang yang menghindari puncak.
segments.tr: 1. Determine departure and return dates that avoid the peak.

segments.src: 2. Pesan tiket atau akomodasi melalui kanal resmi.
segments.tr: 2. Book tickets or accommodation through official channels.

segments.src: 3. Periksa tarif total, syarat pembatalan, dan jadwal terbaru.
segments.tr: 3. Check total fares, cancellation terms, and the latest schedules.

segments.src: 4. Cek kondisi kendaraan atau dokumen perjalanan.
segments.tr: 4. Check vehicle condition or travel documents.

segments.src: 5. Pantau cuaca, informasi lalu lintas, dan pengumuman resmi.
segments.tr: 5. Monitor weather, traffic information, and official announcements.

segments.src: 6. Siapkan uang tunai, uang elektronik, dan kontak darurat.
segments.tr: 6. Prepare cash, electronic money, and emergency contacts.

segments.src: 7. Beri tahu keluarga tentang rencana dan perkiraan waktu tiba.
segments.tr: 7. Inform family about your plans and estimated time of arrival.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Perjalanan Nataru yang nyaman bergantung pada perencanaan, kedisiplinan, dan informasi yang tepat.
segments.tr: A comfortable Nataru trip depends on planning, discipline, and accurate information.

segments.src: Dengan memilih waktu yang lebih lengang, memahami aturan tarif, dan mengutamakan keselamatan, Anda dapat menikmati liburan akhir tahun tanpa stres berlebihan.
segments.tr: By choosing less crowded times, understanding fare rules, and prioritizing safety, you can enjoy your year-end holiday without excessive stress.

segments.src: Selamat merencanakan, dan selamat berlibur dengan aman.
segments.tr: Happy planning, and have a safe holiday.

id-20261123-news-3.title: COP31 and Climate Finance: How to Read Negotiation Results and Their Impact on the Energy Transition and Electricity Bills in Indonesia

segments.src: Setiap kali konferensi iklim PBB selesai, pemberitaan biasanya dipenuhi angka besar dan istilah teknis.
segments.tr: Whenever a UN climate conference ends, the news is usually filled with big numbers and technical terms.

segments.src: Setelah COP31 usai, pertanyaan yang paling relevan bagi pembaca di Indonesia sederhana: apakah hasilnya mengubah cara kita membangun pembangkit listrik, dan apakah itu akan terasa di tagihan listrik rumah tangga?
segments.tr: After COP31 is over, the most relevant question for readers in Indonesia is simple: do the results change how we build power plants, and will it be felt on household electricity bills?

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak merangkum satu per satu pasal dokumen akhir.
segments.tr: This article does not summarize the final document article by article.

segments.src: Tujuannya memberi kerangka untuk membaca hasil perundingan dengan kritis, lalu menghubungkannya dengan isu yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari: pensiun dini PLTU, pengembangan energi terbarukan, dan biaya energi.
segments.tr: Its purpose is to provide a framework for reading negotiation results critically, then connecting them to issues close to daily life: early retirement of coal-fired power plants (PLTU), renewable energy development, and energy costs.

segments.src: Untuk detail naskah keputusan resmi, rujuklah dokumen dan siaran pers dari UNFCCC serta pemerintah Indonesia.
segments.tr: For details of the official decision text, please refer to documents and press releases from the UNFCCC and the Indonesian government.

segments.src: ## Apa yang biasanya diputuskan di COP
segments.tr: ## What is usually decided at COPs

segments.src: COP (*Conference of the Parties*) adalah pertemuan tahunan para pihak dalam Konvensi Kerangka Kerja PBB tentang Perubahan Iklim (UNFCCC).
segments.tr: COP (*Conference of the Parties*) is the annual meeting of parties to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

segments.src: Keputusan diambil secara konsensus, sehingga hasilnya sering berupa kompromi dengan bahasa yang hati-hati.
segments.tr: Decisions are made by consensus, so the results are often compromises with careful language.

segments.src: Pada umumnya, ada tiga kelompok isu yang menjadi sorotan:
segments.tr: Generally, there are three groups of issues in the spotlight:

segments.src: 1. **Pendanaan iklim.** Berapa dana yang dijanjikan negara maju untuk membantu negara berkembang, dari sumber apa, dan dengan skema apa (hibah, pinjaman lunak, atau pinjaman komersial).
segments.tr: 1. **Climate finance.** How much funding is promised by developed countries to help developing countries, from what sources, and under what schemes (grants, soft loans, or commercial loans).

segments.src: 2. **Mitigasi dan target emisi.** Seberapa ambisius target pengurangan emisi tiap negara, yang disebut *Nationally Determined Contributions* (NDC), dan bagaimana kemajuannya diukur.
segments.tr: 2. **Mitigation and emission targets.** How ambitious each country's emission reduction targets are, called *Nationally Determined Contributions* (NDC), and how progress is measured.

segments.src: 3. **Adaptasi serta kerugian dan kerusakan.** Dukungan bagi masyarakat yang sudah terdampak banjir, kekeringan, atau kenaikan muka air laut.
segments.tr: 3. **Adaptation and loss and damage.** Support for communities already affected by floods, droughts, or sea level rise.

segments.src: ## Cara membaca angka pendanaan
segments.tr: ## How to read funding figures

segments.src: Angka pendanaan sering menjadi judul utama, tetapi angka yang sama bisa berarti hal yang sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: Funding figures are often the main headline, but the same number can mean very different things.

segments.src: Beberapa pertanyaan berikut membantu menilai sebuah komitmen:
segments.tr: The following questions help evaluate a commitment:

segments.src: - **Apakah itu komitmen atau pencairan?** Janji dana belum tentu sama dengan dana yang benar-benar masuk. Selisih antara keduanya kerap besar.
segments.tr: - **Is it a commitment or disbursement?** A funding pledge is not necessarily the same as funds actually received. The gap between the two is often large.

segments.src: - **Hibah atau utang?** Dana berbentuk pinjaman tetap harus dibayar. Bagi negara berkembang, porsi hibah dan pinjaman berbunga rendah jauh lebih ringan daripada pinjaman bersuku bunga pasar.
segments.tr: - **Grants or loans?** Funding in the form of loans still has to be repaid. For developing countries, the portion of grants and low-interest loans is much lighter than market-rate loans.

segments.src: - **Dana publik atau swasta?** Sebagian komitmen mengandalkan dana swasta yang "dimobilisasi". Capaiannya bergantung pada iklim investasi dan penjaminan risiko.
segments.tr: - **Public or private funds?** Some commitments rely on private funds that are "mobilized." Achievement depends on the investment climate and risk guarantees.

segments.src: - **Apakah ini dana baru?** Kadang angka yang diumumkan mencakup bantuan pembangunan yang sudah ada, sehingga tidak sepenuhnya tambahan.
segments.tr: - **Is this new money?** Sometimes the announced figures include existing development assistance, so they are not entirely additional.

segments.src: - **Kapan berlaku?** Target jangka panjang, misalnya yang jatuh tempo pada 2030-an, tidak menjawab kebutuhan pendanaan yang mendesak sekarang.
segments.tr: - **When does it apply?** Long-term targets, such as those due in the 2030s, do not answer urgent funding needs now.

segments.src: Sebagai konteks, pada COP29 di Baku para pihak menyepakati sasaran pendanaan iklim dari negara maju sebesar sedikitnya 300 miliar dolar AS per tahun pada 2035, dengan seruan agar seluruh pelaku mengupayakan 1,3 triliun dolar AS per tahun dari berbagai sumber.
segments.tr: As context, at COP29 in Baku, parties agreed on a climate finance goal from developed countries of at least 300 billion US dollars per year by 2035, with a call for all actors to strive for 1.3 trillion US dollars per year from various sources.

segments.src: Banyak negara berkembang menilai angka itu belum memadai.
segments.tr: Many developing countries consider that figure inadequate.

segments.src: Hasil COP31 sebaiknya dibaca sebagai kelanjutan dari kerangka tersebut: apakah ia memperjelas cara mencapainya, atau hanya mengulang janji lama.
segments.tr: The results of COP31 should be read as a continuation of that framework: whether it clarifies how to achieve it, or just repeats old promises.

segments.src: ## Membaca target emisi dengan benar
segments.tr: ## Reading emission targets correctly

segments.src: Target emisi juga perlu dibaca dengan teliti.
segments.tr: Emission targets also need to be read carefully.

segments.src: Ada perbedaan antara target yang tertuang dalam NDC, kebijakan yang benar-benar berjalan, dan emisi yang akhirnya terjadi.
segments.tr: There is a difference between targets stated in NDCs, policies actually implemented, and emissions that ultimately occur.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang perlu dicermati:
segments.tr: Some things to watch out for:

segments.src: - Apakah target mencakup seluruh sektor ekonomi, termasuk kehutanan dan penggunaan lahan, yang bagi Indonesia sangat berpengaruh.
segments.tr: - Whether targets cover all economic sectors, including forestry and land use, which is very influential for Indonesia.

segments.src: - Apakah target bersifat tanpa syarat (dengan upaya sendiri) atau bersyarat pada dukungan internasional.
segments.tr: - Whether targets are unconditional (with own efforts) or conditional on international support.

segments.src: - Apakah ada mekanisme pelaporan dan verifikasi yang jelas, sehingga kemajuan dapat diperiksa publik.
segments.tr: - Whether there is a clear reporting and verification mechanism so that progress can be checked by the public.

segments.src: Hasil perundingan yang bagus di atas kertas tetap perlu diterjemahkan menjadi regulasi nasional, anggaran, dan proyek nyata.
segments.tr: Good negotiation results on paper still need to be translated into national regulations, budgets, and real projects.

segments.src: Di sinilah dampak bagi pembaca di Indonesia baru terasa.
segments.tr: This is where the impact for readers in Indonesia will be felt.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi pensiun dini PLTU
segments.tr: ## Impact on the early retirement of coal-fired power plants (PLTU)

segments.src: Sektor ketenagalistrikan Indonesia masih sangat bergantung pada batu bara, sehingga pensiun dini PLTU menjadi salah satu isu transisi energi yang paling banyak dibicarakan.
segments.tr: Indonesia's electricity sector still heavily relies on coal, making the early retirement of PLTUs one of the most discussed energy transition issues.

segments.src: Pemerintah telah mengeluarkan Peraturan Presiden Nomor 112 Tahun 2022 yang mengatur percepatan pengembangan energi terbarukan untuk penyediaan tenaga listrik, termasuk landasan untuk mengakhiri operasi PLTU secara bertahap.
segments.tr: The government has issued Presidential Regulation Number 112 of 2022 which regulates the acceleration of renewable energy development for electricity supply, including the basis for ending PLTU operations gradually.

segments.src: Skema kemitraan transisi energi seperti JETP (*Just Energy Transition Partnership*) juga dirancang untuk membantu pembiayaannya.
segments.tr: Energy transition partnership schemes like JETP (*Just Energy Transition Partnership*) are also designed to help finance it.

segments.src: Pensiun dini PLTU mahal dan rumit karena beberapa alasan:
segments.tr: Early retirement of PLTUs is expensive and complex for several reasons:

segments.src: - PLTU yang masih muda punya sisa umur ekonomi dan kontrak jual beli listrik jangka panjang, sehingga penghentiannya perlu kompensasi atau skema pembiayaan ulang.
segments.tr: - Young PLTUs have remaining economic life and long-term power purchase agreements, so their shutdown requires compensation or refinancing schemes.

segments.src: - Listrik pengganti harus tersedia dan andal, terutama di sistem seperti Jawa-Bali yang kapasitasnya besar.
segments.tr: - Replacement electricity must be available and reliable, especially in systems like Java-Bali which have large capacities.

segments.src: - Pekerja dan daerah penghasil batu bara perlu jalur transisi yang adil, bukan sekadar penutupan pembangkit.
segments.tr: - Workers and coal-producing regions need a fair transition path, not just plant closures.

segments.src: Karena itu, pertanyaan kuncinya bukan hanya "berapa besar dananya", tetapi juga **syaratnya**.
segments.tr: Therefore, the key question is not only "how much is the funding," but also **the conditions**.

segments.src: Jika hasil COP31 memperkuat pendanaan berbiaya rendah dan hibah untuk transisi, ruang gerak Indonesia mempercepat pensiun PLTU akan lebih lapang.
segments.tr: If COP31 results strengthen low-cost financing and grants for the transition, Indonesia's leeway to accelerate PLTU retirement will be broader.

segments.src: Jika yang dominan hanya pinjaman berbunga tinggi, pelaksanaannya cenderung berjalan lambat atau membebani keuangan negara dan BUMN.
segments.tr: If high-interest loans dominate, implementation is likely to be slow or burden state and SOE finances.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi energi terbarukan
segments.tr: ## Impact on renewable energy

segments.src: Indonesia memiliki potensi besar pada tenaga surya, panas bumi, air, dan angin.
segments.tr: Indonesia has great potential in solar, geothermal, hydro, and wind power.

segments.src: Namun, pertumbuhannya selama ini lebih lambat dari target.
segments.tr: However, its growth has been slower than target so far.

segments.src: Hambatan yang sering disebut meliputi proses perizinan, skema harga, ketersediaan jaringan transmisi, kandungan lokal, dan persepsi risiko investor.
segments.tr: Obstacles often cited include the licensing process, pricing schemes, transmission grid availability, local content, and investor risk perception.

segments.src: Pendanaan iklim bisa membantu pada beberapa titik: menurunkan biaya modal lewat jaminan atau pinjaman lunak, membiayai jaringan transmisi dan penyimpanan energi, serta mendukung proyek di daerah yang kurang menarik bagi investor komersial.
segments.tr: Climate finance can help at several points: lowering capital costs through guarantees or soft loans, financing transmission grids and energy storage, and supporting projects in areas less attractive to commercial investors.

segments.src: Meski begitu, dana saja tidak cukup.
segments.tr: Even so, funds alone are not enough.

segments.src: Kepastian regulasi dan kesiapan PLN sebagai pembeli listrik tetap menentukan apakah proyek benar-benar terbangun.
segments.tr: Regulatory certainty and PLN's readiness as a power buyer remain determinants of whether projects are actually built.

segments.src: ## Apa artinya bagi tagihan listrik rumah tangga
segments.tr: ## What it means for household electricity bills

segments.src: Inilah bagian yang paling sering disalahpahami.
segments.tr: This is the most misunderstood part.

segments.src: Hasil sebuah konferensi iklim tidak langsung mengubah tarif listrik bulan depan.
segments.tr: The results of a climate conference do not directly change next month's electricity rates.

segments.src: Tarif listrik di Indonesia ditetapkan pemerintah melalui Kementerian ESDM, dengan mempertimbangkan biaya pokok penyediaan, subsidi, dan kompensasi kepada PLN.
segments.tr: Electricity rates in Indonesia are set by the government through the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, taking into account the basic cost of supply, subsidies, and compensation to PLN.

segments.src: Dampak keputusan iklim bersifat tidak langsung dan berjalan lewat beberapa jalur:
segments.tr: The impact of climate decisions is indirect and works through several channels:

segments.src: - **Biaya pembangkitan.** Energi surya dan angin kini semakin kompetitif di banyak tempat, tetapi sistem yang lebih bersih membutuhkan investasi tambahan pada jaringan dan penyimpanan. Dalam jangka menengah, biaya itu bisa naik atau turun tergantung seberapa murah pembiayaannya.
segments.tr: - **Generation costs.** Solar and wind energy are now increasingly competitive in many places, but cleaner systems require additional investments in grids and storage. In the medium term, those costs could rise or fall depending on how cheap the financing is.

segments.src: - **Pembiayaan murah.** Makin murah modal yang masuk, makin kecil tekanan terhadap biaya pokok penyediaan listrik. Di sinilah syarat pendanaan iklim berperan.
segments.tr: - **Cheap financing.** The cheaper the incoming capital, the smaller the pressure on the basic cost of electricity supply. This is where climate finance conditions play a role.

segments.src: - **Subsidi dan kompensasi.** Mengganti pembangkit batu bara lebih cepat bisa memerlukan dukungan anggaran. Siapa yang menanggung beban ini, negara, PLN, atau pelanggan, adalah keputusan kebijakan, bukan akibat otomatis dari hasil COP.
segments.tr: - **Subsidies and compensation.** Replacing coal plants faster may require budget support. Who bears this burden—the state, PLN, or customers—is a policy decision, not an automatic consequence of COP results.

segments.src: - **Harga bahan bakar.** Mengurangi ketergantungan pada bahan bakar fosil bisa menurunkan paparan terhadap gejolak harga batu bara dan gas dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: - **Fuel prices.** Reducing dependence on fossil fuels can reduce exposure to coal and gas price volatility in the long run.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, transisi energi dapat menekan atau menaikkan biaya listrik tergantung pada desain kebijakan dan pembiayaannya.
segments.tr: In other words, the energy transition can lower or raise electricity costs depending on policy design and financing.

segments.src: Tidak ada jawaban tunggal yang berlaku untuk semua rumah tangga.
segments.tr: There is no single answer that applies to all households.

segments.src: ## Hal yang bisa dilakukan rumah tangga
segments.tr: ## What households can do

segments.src: Terlepas dari hasil perundingan, ada langkah praktis yang bisa mengendalikan tagihan listrik:
segments.tr: Regardless of the negotiation results, there are practical steps that can control electricity bills:

segments.src: 1. **Periksa konsumsi.** Catat pemakaian kWh bulanan dan kenali peralatan yang paling boros, seperti pendingin ruangan, kulkas lama, dan pemanas air.
segments.tr: 1. **Check consumption.** Record monthly kWh usage and identify the most wasteful appliances, such as air conditioners, old refrigerators, and water heaters.

segments.src: 2. **Pilih peralatan hemat energi.** Label efisiensi energi membantu membandingkan, dan selisih harga biasanya tertutup oleh penghematan listrik dalam beberapa tahun.
segments.tr: 2. **Choose energy-efficient appliances.** Energy efficiency labels help compare, and the price difference is usually covered by electricity savings within a few years.

segments.src: 3. **Pertimbangkan panel surya atap** bila atap dan anggaran memungkinkan. Hitung dulu biaya pemasangan, aturan penyambungan ke jaringan PLN, dan masa balik modal, sebab ketentuannya dapat berubah.
segments.tr: 3. **Consider rooftop solar panels** if your roof and budget allow. Calculate installation costs, PLN grid connection rules, and payback periods first, as regulations can change.

segments.src: 4. **Pantau informasi tarif resmi** dari PLN dan Kementerian ESDM, bukan dari kabar yang beredar tanpa sumber.
segments.tr: 4. **Monitor official tariff information** from PLN and the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, not from unverified rumors.

segments.src: ## Hal yang perlu dicermati ke depan
segments.tr: ## Things to watch moving forward

segments.src: Hasil COP31 baru bermakna jika diikuti tindakan.
segments.tr: The results of COP31 are only meaningful if followed by action.

segments.src: Beberapa indikator yang layak dipantau dalam beberapa bulan mendatang:
segments.tr: Several indicators worth monitoring in the coming months:

segments.src: - Apakah komitmen pendanaan diterjemahkan menjadi mekanisme dan jadwal pencairan yang konkret.
segments.tr: - Whether funding commitments are translated into concrete mechanisms and disbursement schedules.

segments.src: - Bagaimana pemerintah Indonesia memperbarui target dan rencana sektor ketenagalistrikan, termasuk daftar PLTU yang akan dipensiunkan dan jadwalnya.
segments.tr: - How the Indonesian government updates its targets and electricity sector plans, including the list of PLTUs to be retired and their schedules.

segments.src: - Perkembangan proyek JETP dan kemitraan serupa, termasuk komposisi hibah dan pinjamannya.
segments.tr: - The progress of JETP projects and similar partnerships, including the composition of grants and loans.

segments.src: - Kebijakan tarif, subsidi, dan kompensasi listrik yang diumumkan pemerintah.
segments.tr: - Tariff policies, subsidies, and electricity compensation announced by the government.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Cara terbaik membaca hasil COP31 adalah dengan skeptis yang sehat: lihat angkanya, tetapi lebih penting lagi lihat bentuk, syarat, dan jadwal pendanaannya.
segments.tr: The best way to read COP31 results is with healthy skepticism: look at the numbers, but more importantly look at the form, conditions, and schedule of the funding.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, nilai sebuah kesepakatan iklim terukur dari kemampuannya mempercepat pensiun PLTU dan pembangunan energi terbarukan tanpa membebani keuangan negara maupun rumah tangga secara tidak adil.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, the value of a climate agreement is measured by its ability to accelerate PLTU retirement and renewable energy development without unfairly burdening state finances or households.

segments.src: Dampak ke tagihan listrik tidak instan dan tidak seragam; ia ditentukan oleh keputusan kebijakan yang menyusul setelah konferensi usai.
segments.tr: The impact on electricity bills is neither instant nor uniform; it is determined by policy decisions that follow after the conference ends.

segments.tr: *Note: This article is for general information and is not financial or investment advice.

segments.tr: Details of COP31 results may evolve alongside the publication of official documents, so readers are advised to refer to official sources for the latest data.*

id-20261123-consumer-advertising-psychol.title: [Consumer Psychology #13] Why Do Long Queues Make Us Curious? The Power of Others in Shopping Decisions

segments.src: > Kita jarang benar-benar belanja sendirian: pendapat teman, ulasan orang asing, dan "kata orang banyak" ikut menentukan apa yang kita beli.
segments.tr: > We rarely shop truly alone: the opinions of friends, reviews from strangers, and "what people say" all play a part in determining what we buy.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Coba ingat kapan terakhir kali Anda membeli sesuatu tanpa memikirkan pendapat orang lain sama sekali.
segments.tr: Try to remember the last time you bought something without considering anyone else's opinion at all.

segments.src: Mungkin Anda mengecek rating dulu, membeli karena teman kantor sudah pakai, atau menghindari merek tertentu karena takut dianggap "nggak banget".
segments.tr: Maybe you checked the ratings first, bought it because a coworker already used it, or avoided a certain brand for fear of being considered "not cool".

segments.src: Dalam psikologi konsumen, semua ini disebut **pengaruh sosial**, yaitu berubahnya pikiran, perasaan, atau tindakan kita karena kehadiran orang lain, baik nyata maupun dibayangkan.
segments.tr: In consumer psychology, this is all called **social influence**, which is the change in our thoughts, feelings, or actions due to the presence of others, whether real or imagined.

segments.src: Ada tiga konsep kunci di dalamnya.
segments.tr: There are three key concepts within it.

segments.src: Kelompok rujukan (reference group)**
segments.tr: Reference group**

segments.src: Ini adalah orang atau kelompok yang kita jadikan patokan untuk menilai diri dan pilihan kita.
segments.tr: This is the person or group we use as a benchmark to evaluate ourselves and our choices.

segments.src: - **Kelompok keanggotaan**: kelompok tempat kita berada, seperti keluarga, teman kuliah, atau rekan kerja.
segments.tr: - **Membership group**: groups we belong to, such as family, college friends, or coworkers.

segments.src: - **Kelompok aspirasi**: kelompok yang ingin kita masuki, misalnya profesional sukses atau kreator yang kita kagumi.
segments.tr: - **Aspirational group**: groups we want to join, such as successful professionals or creators we admire.

segments.src: - **Kelompok disosiatif**: kelompok yang tidak ingin kita samai, sehingga kita menjauhi produk yang identik dengan mereka.
segments.tr: - **Dissociative group**: groups we do not want to be associated with, so we avoid products identical to them.

segments.src: Pengaruh kelompok rujukan biasanya lebih kuat pada produk yang **terlihat oleh orang lain** (ponsel, sepatu, pakaian) dibandingkan produk yang dipakai secara pribadi (misalnya sabun cuci piring).
segments.tr: The influence of reference groups is usually stronger for products that are **visible to others** (phones, shoes, clothing) compared to products used privately (e.g., dish soap).

segments.src: Getok tular (word of mouth)**
segments.tr: Word of mouth**

segments.src: Rekomendasi atau keluhan yang beredar antar-konsumen, bukan dari iklan resmi.
segments.tr: Recommendations or complaints circulating among consumers, not from official advertisements.

segments.src: Dulu lewat obrolan arisan atau warung kopi, sekarang juga lewat kolom komentar, grup WhatsApp, dan video ulasan.
segments.tr: It used to be through social gatherings or coffee shop chats, now it's also through comment sections, WhatsApp groups, and review videos.

segments.src: Getok tular cenderung lebih dipercaya karena dianggap tidak dibayar, walaupun di era *endorse* anggapan itu tidak selalu benar.
segments.tr: Word of mouth tends to be more trusted because it is considered unpaid, although in the era of *endorsements*, that assumption is not always true.

segments.src: Bukti sosial (social proof)**
segments.tr: Social proof**

segments.src: Saat ragu, kita melihat apa yang dilakukan orang lain dan menganggapnya sebagai petunjuk yang benar.
segments.tr: When in doubt, we look at what others are doing and take it as the correct cue.

segments.src: Istilah ini dipopulerkan oleh psikolog Robert Cialdini.
segments.tr: This term was popularized by psychologist Robert Cialdini.

segments.src: Logikanya: "Kalau banyak orang memilih ini, mungkin memang bagus."
segments.tr: The logic: "If many people choose this, it must be good."

segments.src: Efeknya paling kuat ketika situasinya **tidak pasti** dan orang lain itu **mirip dengan kita**.
segments.tr: The effect is strongest when the situation is **uncertain** and the other people are **similar to us**.

segments.src: Bukti sosial adalah jalan pintas berpikir.
segments.tr: Social proof is a mental shortcut.

segments.src: Sering kali berguna, tapi bisa menyesatkan, misalnya ketika ulasannya palsu atau antreannya sengaja diciptakan.
segments.tr: It is often useful, but it can be misleading, for example when reviews are fake or queues are intentionally created.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda sedang di sebuah mal di Jakarta.
segments.tr: Imagine you are at a mall in Jakarta.

segments.src: Ada dua kedai minuman kekinian bersebelahan dengan harga hampir sama, sekitar Rp25.000 per gelas.
segments.tr: There are two trendy drink stalls next to each other with similar prices, around Rp25,000 per cup.

segments.src: Kedai A sepi, sedangkan antrean Kedai B mengular.
segments.tr: Stall A is empty, while the queue for Stall B is snaking.

segments.src: Kebanyakan orang akan tergoda melirik Kedai B.
segments.tr: Most people will be tempted to glance at Stall B.

segments.src: Antrean itu bekerja sebagai **bukti sosial**: "Pasti enak, buktinya ramai."
segments.tr: That queue works as **social proof**: "It must be delicious, the proof is that it's crowded."

segments.src: Lalu Anda membuka ponsel.
segments.tr: Then you open your phone.

segments.src: Ternyata minuman Kedai B sempat viral di TikTok dan dibahas di grup WhatsApp kantor.
segments.tr: It turns out Stall B's drink went viral on TikTok and was discussed in your office WhatsApp group.

segments.src: Itu **getok tular**.
segments.tr: That's **word of mouth**.

segments.src: Seorang teman yang selera kulinernya Anda percaya juga pernah mengunggah fotonya.
segments.tr: A friend whose culinary taste you trust has also posted a photo of it.

segments.src: Teman itu bagian dari **kelompok rujukan** Anda.
segments.tr: That friend is part of your **reference group**.

segments.src: Ketiga pengaruh ini saling menguatkan, sampai Anda rela antre 20 menit untuk minuman yang belum tentu jauh berbeda dari Kedai A.
segments.tr: These three influences reinforce each other, until you are willing to queue for 20 minutes for a drink that may not be much different from Stall A.

segments.src: Pelaku bisnis memahami pola ini.
segments.tr: Business owners understand this pattern.

segments.src: Itu sebabnya toko daring menampilkan "10rb+ terjual", rating bintang, dan label "Terlaris", sementara merek bekerja sama dengan kreator yang dekat dengan target pasarnya.
segments.tr: That's why online stores display "10k+ sold", star ratings, and "Best Seller" labels, while brands collaborate with creators who are close to their target market.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. **Kelompok rujukan** menjadi patokan pilihan kita, terutama untuk produk yang terlihat orang lain.
segments.tr: 1. **Reference groups** become our benchmark for choices, especially for products visible to others.

segments.src: 2. **Getok tular** dari sesama konsumen sering lebih dipercaya daripada iklan resmi.
segments.tr: 2. **Word of mouth** from fellow consumers is often more trusted than official advertising.

segments.src: 3. **Bukti sosial** membuat kita mengikuti pilihan orang banyak saat ragu. Ini jalan pintas yang berguna, tapi bisa dimanipulasi.
segments.tr: 3. **Social proof** makes us follow the choices of the crowd when in doubt. It is a useful shortcut, but it can be manipulated.
